column1: # timeout-budgets.tsv - FLMX timeout-budget registry (R8 T-GATE standing gate).
# Canonical artifact for x-verdicts-r8.md §7 batch T-GATE. Seeded from the
# r8-lane-t.md closed matrix as corrected by fix batches A (server relief),
# B (frontend table), C (agent download budget) and D, plus the T-GATE
# batch's own completion of R8-T-07 for /tunnel/create.
#   call        frontend export name / chain name (census key)
#   surface     fe | fe-raw | fe-stream | fe-external | internal | federation | agent | mirror
#   fe_s        frontend (caller) budget, seconds (empty for formula rows: see fe_floor_s/fe_cap_s)
#   fe_kind     literal | default | const | formula | dynamic | none
#   fe_src      extraction anchor used by scripts/check-timeout-budgets.sh
#   fe_cap_s    formula rows: cap, seconds (empty = uncapped)
#   sv_s        effective server write limit, seconds (endpoint relief or the global WriteTimeout)
#   sv_src      'global' (app.go WriteTimeout) or the relief constant symbol
#   be_s        backend bound, seconds (empty when composite/unbounded/formula: see note)
#   be_kind     const | literal | expr | formula | composite | unbounded | class | db | var
#   be_src      constant symbol / literal anchor / derivation source
#   check       strict | aligned | formula | composite | class | exception | observed | pin | agent
#   exception   named exception (registry-row property; empty = none). An
#               exception is a deliberate, reasoned registration - the note
#               column carries the reason and the residual it leaves open.
#   item        adjudicated item id (R8-T-xx) or '-' for OK/observed rows
#   note        derivation, residual, or registration reason
#   strict:    fe > be and sv > be, both with margin; all three values are
#              mechanically extracted from the tree and must equal this table.
#   aligned:   be is unbounded; fe == sv == the registered aligned budget.
#   formula:   fe/be are formulas; extracted helper parameters / literals /
#              constants must equal this table (drift detection).
#   composite: be is a composite of legs with no single constant; fe/sv are
#              extracted and must equal this table (drift detection).
#   class:     DB/local class; fe extracted must equal this table and fe > be.
#   exception: values reconciled like composite, plus a named exception.
#   observed:  registered for census closure; values reconciled, no verdict.
#   pin:       internal bound; the Go gate test pins be to the product constant.
#   agent:     cross-client pair; agent budget must stay below panel patience.
# Census rule: every exported call in vite-frontend/src/api/index.ts plus the
# two diagnosis-stream surfaces must appear exactly once in the call column;
# an unregistered call point fails the gate (verdict §7 T-GATE (2)).
# Named Go constants are additionally pinned by Go gate tests
